remarks: Welcome to 279 Sumner Road in Darien, located in Genesee County and the Alden School District! Situated on just under 2 beautifully landscaped acres, this updated home offers the perfect combination of modern finishes, open living spaces, and country charm. Step inside through the perfectly placed mudroom/entryway and into a stunning open-concept living area featuring soaring ceilings, beautiful flooring, and a sleek glass fireplace that creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. The spacious dining area flows seamlessly into the updated kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances, breakfast bar, and plenty of room for entertaining. French doors off the living room lead to a rear porch overlooking the picturesque backyard, offering the perfect setting to relax and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. The first floor also features the convenience of laundry, with new flooring installed throughout in 2025. Additional improvements include updated plumbing and electrical throughout, a roof approximately 12 years old, and a newly drilled well in 2025. Outside, the property truly shines with beautiful landscaping, a storage shed, and an impressive two-story barn equipped with electric, a separate electrical subpanel, and a propane furnace, offering incredible space for storage, hobbies, a workshop, or recreational use. With nearly 2 acres to enjoy, this property offers the space, privacy, and versatility you've been looking for while remaining within the Alden School District. Public tax records indicate 2 bedrooms; however, the home currently features 3 bedrooms. A unique opportunity to enjoy updated country living with room to spread out!
